package_evaluations.target_family_profile: Small families, estranged relatives, or those facing severe budget constraints who desire a simple, private send-off without a public wake or visitation service.
package_evaluations.core_value_proposition: A highly cost-effective, dignified, and direct afterlife arrangement focusing on essential logistics, body care, and cremation without additional ceremonial overhead.
key_advantages: Lowest base cost in the portfolio (S$1,500 excl. GST)
Zero logistics for venue, catering, and visitor coordination
Complimentary sea scattering or ash handover included
key_limitations_and_disadvantages: No public wake, visitation, or memorial service allowed under this package
Does not include religious officiants or rites in the base price
No dedicated on-site Funeral Butler support (only transport/pallbearer team)
best_suited_for: Deceased who explicitly requested no wake/fuss
Families with minimal local social circles
Urgent or pro bono cases where immediate cremation is necessary
not_recommended_for: Families wanting multi-day community or relative gatherings
Situations requiring complex dialect or traditional religious rites at a wake
package_evaluations.upgrade_triggers: Upgrade to Standard Service Tier if the family decides they require at least a 3-day wake for close relatives to pay their respects.
package_evaluations.downgrade_triggers: N/A (this is the entry-level package; downgrade to pro bono assistance is coordinated separately via corporate CSR channels).
package_evaluations.value_justification: Covers essential transport from hospital or home, standard eco-wood casket, professional embalming/styling, Mandai Crematorium fees, and ash collection. All necessary logistics for a basic, legal, and respectful send-off are covered under one flat fee.

package_evaluations.target_family_profile: Families seeking a quiet, simple, and respectful wake arrangement on a manageable budget, without decorative additions or extensive custom styling.
package_evaluations.core_value_proposition: Essential wake coordination and standard amenities for a traditional multi-day service, offering dignified setups without premium price points.
key_advantages: Covers essential 3-day wake canvas setup and coordination with town councils
Professional embalming and casket included in the base rate
Affordable entry point for a public wake (S$3,200 excl. GST)
key_limitations_and_disadvantages: Basic eco-wood casket with natural finish (no premium timber options)
Standard multi-purpose hearse for procession (no Mercedes-Benz or glass vehicle)
Only 1 dedicated operations coordinator on-site for wake setup, rather than full-time presence
best_suited_for: Quiet wakes with low to moderate guest numbers
Families looking to focus on religious customs rather than custom floral styles
not_recommended_for: High-profile funerals expecting hundreds of guests
Families desiring customized decorative themes or premium transport vehicles
package_evaluations.upgrade_triggers: Upgrade to Deluxe Dignity Service if the family wants upgraded floral styling, a custom photo frame, more staff support, or a premium Mercedes hearse.
package_evaluations.downgrade_triggers: Downgrade to Direct Cremation if a wake is no longer requested or budget becomes extremely limited.
package_evaluations.value_justification: Pays for professional embalming, local regulatory coordination, essential 3-day logistics (tables, chairs, utilities), casket, hearse, and a dedicated coordinator for setup. Offers full ceremony capability on a budget.

package_evaluations.target_family_profile: Families who want a complete, polished, and aesthetically pleasing memorial setup to host relatives, friends, and colleagues comfortably.
package_evaluations.core_value_proposition: The most popular package choice, combining elegant wake styling, upgraded transport, and dedicated coordination for a highly professional and memorable service.
key_advantages: Upgraded Mercedes-Benz black hearse for procession day
Custom floral surround for the departed portrait and detailed backdrop styling
2 dedicated operations staff on-site throughout the wake
key_limitations_and_disadvantages: Casket is standard eco-wood (upgrades to solid timber caskets require additional fees)
Does not include full 24/7 concierge Butler service (requires premium upgrade)
best_suited_for: Standard HDB void deck or parlour setups requiring a clean, modern aesthetic
Families anticipating moderate to high guest counts over 3 to 5 days
not_recommended_for: Families on an extremely tight budget
VIP or very large funerals requiring comprehensive 24/7 event management
package_evaluations.upgrade_triggers: Upgrade to Premium Heritage Service if solid wood caskets, custom high-end floral installations, VIP lounge setups, and a 24/7 Funeral Butler are desired.
package_evaluations.downgrade_triggers: Downgrade to Standard if the family prefers a minimalist setup and wants to reduce cost by S$1,300.
package_evaluations.value_justification: Delivers superior value by bundling upgraded floral layouts, a Mercedes-Benz hearse, premium embalming/cosmetic work, and 2 operations staff to assist. Eliminates coordination stress for families.

package_evaluations.target_family_profile: Families expecting large guest numbers, high-profile visitors, or seeking comprehensive VIP management, premium caskets, and bespoke styling.
package_evaluations.core_value_proposition: The ultimate concierge-level afterlife service, offering bespoke floral designs, premium transport, solid wood casket options, and dedicated 24/7 Butler support.
key_advantages: Includes a solid polished oak/teak casket option in comparison highlights
Premium glass hearse for a grand and dignified procession
Bespoke high-end floral installations and custom altar styling
3 dedicated operations managers available 24/7, plus a 24/7 Funeral Butler
Complimentary livestreaming of services for overseas relatives
key_limitations_and_disadvantages: Highest base price in the standard product line (S$6,800 excl. GST)
May feel overly elaborate for small, private family gatherings
best_suited_for: Large community funerals with extensive guest lists
Families desiring the highest standard of care, transport, and materials
Overseas family members needing high-definition livestream coordination
package_evaluations.upgrade_triggers: N/A (this is the highest standard tier; custom luxury options can be tailored on request)
package_evaluations.downgrade_triggers: Downgrade to Deluxe Dignity Service if the family wants to maintain standard professional coordination but does not require a 24/7 butler, glass hearse, or solid wood caskets.
package_evaluations.value_justification: Pays for premium materials (solid oak/teak caskets), high-end custom florist artistry, top-tier procession hearse, livestreaming capabilities, and absolute peace-of-mind with a dedicated 24/7 Funeral Butler handling all on-site and behind-the-scenes needs.
